description: This file defines a factory class for creating platform-specific port objects, along with related configuration functions and options parsing for a testing framework within the WebKit project.

classes.name: PortFactory
classes.description: A factory class to instantiate platform-specific port objects based on host platform and configuration.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes PortFactory with a host object.

methods.name: _default_port
methods.description: Determines default port name based on host platform.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns an instance of a port class implementing the Port interface, based on port name or platform.

methods.name: all_port_names
methods.description: Returns list of all valid port names for a given platform.

methods.name: get_from_builder_name
methods.description: Retrieves port object based on builder name.
